    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.nonempty_iso_of_isEFinite_of_stable_of_class_eq {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (h : IsEFinite R) (g : ProjectiveClass R) {S T : FGModuleCat R} (hS : ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsStable S) (hT : ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsStable T) (he : GrothendieckGroup.of S = GrothendieckGroup.of T) :
    Nonempty (S ≅ T)

    At a fixed integral projective weight, a stable module of a given ambient class is unique up to isomorphism in an E-finite algebra.
